description.narrative: "Ökad tillgång till frihet och rättvisa i Bosnien och Hercegovina 2012 - 2015" syftar till att 1) ge medborgarna att hävda sina mänskliga rättigheter 2) att påverka staten att ta ansvar för uppfyllandet av de mänskliga rättigheterna och 3) för att ge de lokala mänskliga rättigheter försvarare.

“Increasing Access to Freedom and Justice in Bosnia and Herzegovina 2012 – 2015” aims to 1) empower citizens to claim their human rights 2) to influence the state to take responsibility for the fulfilment of human rights and 3) to empower the local human rights defenders.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2015Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: The people of Bosnia and Hercegovina, BiH is still facing difficulties in accessing their rights. Even though BiH has signed and ratified all major human rights conventions, the application of existing legislation remains very poor. Laws are still fragmented and not harmonized on the 4 different governing levels (State, Rupublika Srpska, Federation BiH and Brcko district). The law on free legal aid has once again been removed from the procedure of enactment and RS rejects the adoption of a state-level law. The program of Civil Rights Defenders may not show concrete results in relation to the overall intended outcome - in terms of increased access to freedom and justice and increased respectg for civil and political rights. The changes in legislation in line with proposed amendments has been minor. This is due to the fact that the responsiveness of state institutions is low as the constitution does not promote a unified response to civil society advocacy. The result of the intervention is more visible when looking at the effects of Civil Rights Defenders' work with empowering journalists, members of marginalised and minority groups as well as whistle- blowers in cases of corruption. The program has also shown results in strengthening the partners organisations. The partners' knowledge and understanding of methodology and proceses has increased.
